scope: Fixed-rule retrospective extrapolation audit of archived observations. All outcomes have been discussed before; not a blind prospective preregistration. Local computations only; no new flights, simulations or Thor access.
input_rule: Only planned prefix and suffix metadata. No initial/B_before measured states, future event status, outcome-derived summaries, run ID, block, seed or timestamps as model inputs. Replicates of a configuration always held out together. Fit configuration means with equal weights.

P13_suffix: planned gap / 2; zero for no B
P3_suffix: N2 teacher-forced memory / applied previous command
N2s free shadow memory / own previous command
N3 restored exit memory and command
features.P3_interpretation: Treatment includes both memory maintenance during inactivity and reentry operation; the suffix vector represents this planned program, not a freely exchangeable post-prefix action.

targets.P13: whole-task FAILURE, including censor-triggered failures; no inference of safe height from censored height
targets.P3: second_C_to_N motor.step_at_change (normalized motor command); every trial task-success, no failure detection claim

methods.state_split: At most 1/2/3/4 prefix states. Greedy binary guards on prefix features only; require differing training outcomes for an exactly shared suffix and at least two repetitions per side. Each leaf has a quadratic suffix-only ridge response head. Split chosen by training squared-error reduction with ridge-regularized heads; number of states and ridge alpha selected by leave-one-training-configuration-out MSE. This is an offline response-equivalence abstraction, not an implementation or guarantee of full active automata learning.
methods.pooled_suffix: No-split ablation; quadratic suffix-only ridge; alpha selected by training-only configuration CV.
methods.cheap_rank: Same full admissible inputs; choose among linear/quadratic ridge with alpha 0.01/0.1/1/10, and CART depth 1/2/3/4, min leaf 1/2, by training-only configuration CV MSE. Tie uses listed order. Also publish the ridge and CART sub-baselines separately.
methods.lookup: Exact configuration lookup if observed, otherwise nearest training configuration in full normalized metadata using squared Euclidean distance. Average all equidistant neighbors. No label-based tuning.

evaluation.pools: P13: held-out B-containing candidates within family and block. P3: held-out treatments within condition and repetition. These are recorded comparable pools, not same-state counterfactual outcomes.
evaluation.selection: Maximize raw regression score (P13) or predicted motor step (P3). Do not clip scores for ranking. Round to 10 decimals for ties, handled analytically with uniform random tie-breaking.
metrics: expected first-choice failure hit or selected motor step
expected first failure rank when one exists
P3 first-choice regret and worst-case hit
state_split vs baselines changed top-choice distributions and wins/ties/losses
evaluation.controls: Report all-safe and saturated pools. Overlapping folds are correlated and are not independent trials. No significance claims. State map gain is measured by held-out prediction error against no-split, not in-sample fit or empirical lookup counts.

validation: configuration disjointness and complete replicate retention
held-out outcome mutation does not change any prediction
interpretation: Any gain supports only these implementations on these finite recorded pools. Absence of gain does not disprove every automata method; it removes the current evidence for an independent search contribution. No unrecorded continuation or active-query savings can be inferred.
revision: Correct scoring bug after initial results: use raw regression scores for ranking; clip to [0,1] only for P13 map/Brier error. Prior outputs preserved under superseded-clipped-ranking. No fits, hyperparameters or folds changed.
